lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's nine? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 9? Nope!

lines.text: A convex polygon has two square corners. Every other corner is one hundred sixty degrees.
lines.caption: A convex polygon has 2 square corners. Every other corner is 160°.

lines.text: How many sides does it have?
lines.caption: How many sides does it have?

lines.text: Walk around the outside. Your turns always add up to three hundred sixty.
lines.caption: Walk around the outside. Your turns always add up to 360.

lines.text: Square corners turn you ninety. The others turn you just twenty.
lines.caption: Square corners turn you 90. The others turn you just 20.

lines.text: Square corners use one hundred eighty. That leaves one hundred eighty.
lines.caption: Square corners use 180. That leaves 180.

lines.text: One hundred eighty divided by twenty is nine corners!
lines.caption: 180 divided by 20 is 9 corners!

lines.text: Nine plus the two square ones. That's eleven sides!
lines.caption: 9 plus the 2 square ones. That's 11 sides!

lines.text: Nine was the trap. Don't forget the square corners!
lines.caption: 9 was the trap. Don't forget the square corners!

lines.text: Did you get eleven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 11? Tell me below!
